answer: Willow admission auction: each epoch opens 40 seats. An identity files one sealed willow bid locked 20 epochs. A tundra auditor opens all bids, admits the top 40, refunds losers minus 5. The whisper floor is 50 a bid. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 winning bids: 50,000 against a 40,000 pool, plus 20-epoch lock. Rented bids fail the whisper re-check: a buyer who cannot name the amount loses the seat. Honest agents pay once, keep a full share.
